steps.name: Validate Kubernetes manifests
steps.run:
find apps/pki -name "*.yaml" -type f | while read file; do
  echo "Validating $file"
  kubectl apply --dry-run=client -f "$file" || exit 1
done

steps.name: Check for secrets in manifests
steps.run:
if grep -r "password:" apps/pki/ --include="*.yaml" | grep -v "password-change-me"; then
  echo "ERROR: Hardcoded passwords found in manifests"
  exit 1
fi

echo "No hardcoded passwords found"

steps.name: Validate policy syntax
steps.run:
python3 -c "
import yaml
with open('apps/pki/cert-worker/configmap-policy.yaml') as f:
    config = yaml.safe_load(f)
    policies = config['data']['policies.yaml']
    policy_config = yaml.safe_load(policies)
    print(f'Validated {len(policy_config["policies"])} policies')
"

steps.name: Validate PQC config
steps.run:
python3 -c "
import yaml
with open('apps/pki/cert-worker/configmap-pqc.yaml') as f:
    config = yaml.safe_load(f)
    pqc = yaml.safe_load(config['data']['pqc-policy.yaml'])
    print(f'Validated PQC policy with {len(pqc["policy"]["algorithms"])}} algorithm categories')
"

steps.name: Validate SQL schema
Validate Python syntax
steps.run:
python3 -m py_compile apps/pki/cert-api/main.py
python3 -m py_compile apps/pki/cert-worker/main.py

echo "Python syntax validation passed"
